main_text.p: converfum eft. Ibidem cum Sin, שְׁבְנָא [?] v.7. R.Saadias exponit Organum.

סבל Portavit, Tulit, Bajulavit: Praeter. סַבְּלוּ Ferimus, Thren.5.7. Pyh. Partic. מְסַבְּלִים Portare facti, Onusti, Onerati, carne scil. & pinguedine, id est, Pra-pingues, Psal.144.4. Chald. Partic. מְסַבְּלִין Onusta, id est, firma, ut magnum Onus portare possint, Esrae 6.3. vel Portantia, sensu eodem. Est autem ex forma Pohal,pro מְסַבְּלִין. Hithp.Futur. וַיִּסְתַּבֵּל Et onustam reddit se, Eccles.12.5. alii 7.
סבל m. Bajulus, Nehem.4.10. Onus,1.Reg.5.15. Plural. הַסַּבָּלִים Bajuli, 2.Par.34.13.
סבל m. Onus: סַבָּל לְכָל סַבָּל Super omne onus, 1.Reg.11.28.
סבל m. Idem: Aff. סִבְלוֹ Oneris ejus, Jesa.9.4.
סִבְלָה f. Idem: Plural. סִבְלֹת Onera, Exod.6.6. Aff. בִּסִבְלֹתָם Onera eorum, Exod.2.11.
סבר Chald. Cogitavit, Putavit, Existimavit: Futur. וְיִסְבַּר Et cogitabit, Dan.7.25.

סגד Adoravit, Procubuit, adorandi vel honorandi causâ: Construitur cum Dativo: Futur. אֶסְגֹּוד Procumbam, Jes.44.19. וַיִּסְגַּד־לְמוֹ Et procumbit eis, v.15. יִסְגְּדוּ Procumbunt, Jesa.46.6. Chald.Praet. סְגַד Ado-ravit, Dan.2.46. Particip. סָגְדִין לְצֶלֶם Adorantes sta-tuam, Dan.3.7. Futur. וְיִסְגֹּד Et adorabit, Dan.3.6. נִסְגַּד Adorabimus, Dan.3.18. וְתִסְגְּדוּן Et adorabitis sta-tuam, v.5.
סגל סְגֻלָּה f. Peculium, Exod.19.5. Aff. לִסְגֻלָּתוֹ In peculium suum, Psal.135.4.
סגן Antistes, Princeps Babyloniæ: סְגָנִים Antistites, Jesa.41.25. וּסְגָנֶיהָ Et antistites ejus, Jerem.51.57. Chald. סִגְנִין Antistitum, Dan.2.48. & סִגְנָיָא Dan.3.2.

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek vocalisation is partly unclear at this scan resolution; doubtful Hebrew letters and points are not marked individually except where noted. The large root letters (ס) open each entry. The first line is the end of an entry from the previous page. Long s is normalised to s throughout, and "eft"/"s" forms are read as est/s. Uncertain readings: "Quare in" line and the Chaldee forms in the first entry.
